title: Catalyst Pedestal — Pickup & Persistence
description: The catalyst lives inside a wireframe cube pedestal in the lab. Player walks up, grabs the crystal, cage fades away. On map transitions the catalyst auto-respawns on the same controller. On game restart everything resets — player picks it up again from the pedestal.
summary: Pedestal in lab, grab crystal, cage fades. Survives map changes (in-memory). Fresh each game launch.
earned_from: Catalyst pedestal session — built wireframe display case, fixed auto_absorb missing voxel mode activation, switched from disk persistence to in-memory only

nodes.label: Player enters lab
nodes.detail: Game launch or first lab visit. CatalystCapabilityManager has no saved state — _bracelet_activated is false, no catalyst on any controller.

nodes.label: Pedestal spawns from map interactables
nodes.detail: map_data.json has 'catalyst_pedestal' in the interactables layer. GridInteractablesComponent instantiates catalyst_pedestal.tscn at the grid cell. The pedestal builds 12 wireframe edges (1m cube), spawns a BecomingCatalyst crystal inside, and starts the bob/spin animation.

nodes.label: Player grabs the crystal
nodes.detail: XRToolsPickable fires picked_up signal. BecomingCatalyst._on_picked_up() shrinks crystal into hand, then _absorb_into_hand() fires. Pedestal receives picked_up signal too — starts cage fade (1.5s) then queue_free().

nodes.label: Crystal absorbs, voxel mode activates
nodes.detail: _absorb_into_hand() reparents catalyst to controller, kills physics, connects trigger button, calls _activate_voxel_mode(). This finds GridStructureComponent and XRCamera3D for head raycasting. CatalystCapabilityManager spawns the bracelet on the same controller.

nodes.label: Player builds with head raycast
nodes.detail: Voxel editor active — head ray, ghost cubes, trigger to place, double-trigger to remove. See minecraft-cube-placer flow for details.

nodes.label: Player transitions to new map?
nodes.detail: Teleporter, scene manager, or direct map load triggers a scene change.

nodes.label: Auto-respawn on new controller
nodes.detail: CatalystCapabilityManager._on_node_added() detects new XRController3D. Checks _bracelet_activated (in-memory flag). Calls _respawn_absorbed_catalyst() which creates a fresh catalyst, calls auto_absorb(ctrl). auto_absorb() now includes call_deferred('_activate_voxel_mode'). Then spawns bracelet.

nodes.label: Game restarted?
nodes.detail: App closed and reopened. CatalystCapabilityManager autoload reinitializes — all in-memory state cleared. _bracelet_activated = false. No save_state() writes to disk, no _load_saved_progress() reads.

nodes.label: Fresh start — find pedestal again
nodes.detail: No catalyst on hand, no bracelet. Player must find and pick up the catalyst from the pedestal in the lab. unlocked_modes starts at ["voxel_editor"] only.

nodes.label: Cycle continues
nodes.detail: Per-session: pick up once, keep forever across maps. Per-game: always fresh.
